{"metadata":{"description":"A DeepSeek Harness plugin that puts graft — a prebuilt graph of every symbol, its file:line span, and who calls what — in front of both you and the model.","id":"gh:1374086773","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-graft-plugin","slug":"adithyanraj03/dsh-graft-plugin","topics":["ai-agents","code-graph","code-indexing","code-intelligence","context-engineering","developer-tools","dsh","dsh-plugin","graft","javascript","llm","static-analysis"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness plugin that puts graft — a prebuilt graph of every symbol, its file:line span, an"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"d who calls what — in front of both you and the model."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-graft-plugin"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness plugin that puts graft — a prebuilt graph of every symbol, its `file:line` span, "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"and who calls what — in front of both you and the model."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"It does four things:"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- **A chip in the composer** naming the graft index the current session is actually serving, whether"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" it still matches the code, and how many tokens graft has saved in that repo. Its card carries a **B"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"uild** button — rebuild the index, or create the first one.
- **Five tools for the model** — `graft_"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"ask`, `graft_grep`, `graft_callers`, `graft_skeleton`, `graft_map` — resolved per session, so one ds"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"h can serve several workspaces at once, git worktrees included, each with its own graph.
- **`/graft"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"`** to build or rebuild the index, and **auto-rebuild** after the model edits files.
- **A `graft vi"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"z` button** that opens the graph in dsh's built-in right sidebar (0.1.5+), in dsh-better-sidebar if "},{"id":"p6s8","text":"you still run it, and in a browser tab as the last resort."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"**pnpm 10 and later block `postinstall` scripts from unapproved packages**, and dsh skips writing th"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"e plugin's bundle row whenever the install exits non-zero — the dependency lands, the plugin stays i"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"nvisible, and dsh starts up cleanly with no error to search for. If `add` ends with `ERR_PNPM_IGNORE"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"D_BUILDS`, approve and re-run it:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Confirm it mounted — the plugin must appear in **both** `dependencies` and `dsh.profile.bundles` in "},{"id":"p11s2","text":"the profile's `package.json`:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Every tool here shells out to the `graft` CLI, so it needs `@nanonets/graft` on PATH:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"A `postinstall` does this for you **when your package manager runs lifecycle scripts** — under pnpm "},{"id":"p15s2","text":"10+ they are blocked by default, so treat the command above as the required step there, not a fallba"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"ck. If your global npm prefix needs elevation, the postinstall says so and prints the one command to"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"lobal npm prefix needs elevation, the postinstall says so and prints the one command to run by hand."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Then index a repo once:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"### In the desktop app"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"The desktop dsh installs plugins from its own **Plugins** settings — no CLI, no profile directory:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"1. Open **Plugins** (settings, left sidebar) and click **Add plugin**.
2. Paste the GitHub repositor"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"y address into the field (the package name `dsh-graft-plugin` works too):"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"3. Click **Install**."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"The dialog switches to the **Installed** confirmation, and the plugin appears under **Installed** at"},{"id":"p23s2","text":" the bottom of the settings page:"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"> The dialog notes that installed plugins **do not update automatically yet** — to upgrade, uninstal"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"l and install again. The graft CLI requirement (`npm install -g @nanonets/graft`) is the same."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"### The sidebar tab"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"On dsh `0.1.5` and later the button opens the graph in **dsh's own right sidebar** — a tab titled Gr"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"aft, also listed on the sidebar's guide page as "The graft graph for this workspace" — and a second "},{"id":"p26s3","text":"click focuses the tab that is already open. No install needed for that path: the registration is sof"},{"id":"p26s4","text":"t, so an older dsh without the right sidebar falls through to `dsh-better-sidebar` when it is mounte"},{"id":"p26s5","text":"d, and to a browser tab when neither is there."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"If your profile still runs `dsh-better-sidebar`, that path is tried **first** and behaves exactly as"},{"id":"p27s2","text":" before. From 0.3.0 it is an **optional peer dependency** — dsh no longer downloads it for you, so a"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"dd it yourself when you want it (on dsh `0.1.5-rc.2` or later it cannot mount anyway, so most profil"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"es should skip this):"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"> **Compatibility.** `dsh-better-sidebar` 0.18.x requires `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`, w"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"hich dsh removed in `0.1.5-rc.2`. On that version or later it will not mount — which is exactly the "},{"id":"p29s3","text":"profiles where the built-in right sidebar takes over instead. Everything else in this plugin — chip,"},{"id":"p29s4","text":" tools, `/graft`, auto-rebuild — is unaffected."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"The chip, the tools, `/graft` and the auto-rebuild all work without any sidebar; the button simply f"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"alls back to a browser tab when neither one is present."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"> This plugin does **not** insert a `dsh-better-sidebar` row itself, on purpose. That package's own "},{"id":"p31s2","text":"bundle row carries a guard that disables it when another enabled row already mounts the same package"},{"id":"p31s3","text":". A second row with a different id makes that guard circular, and the losing outcome is *your existi"},{"id":"p31s4","text":"ng sidebar silently disabling itself*. One explicit command is worth more than that risk."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## What you get"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"### The chip"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"Sits in the composer next to the model name:"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"Hovering (or clicking) opens a card with the resolved root, node and edge counts, freshness, the run"},{"id":"p36s2","text":"ning saved-token tally, and the `graft viz` button."},{"id":"p37s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"| dsh | status |"},{"id":"p40s1","text":"| `0.2.1-rc.2` | test suites pass against the `0.2.1-rc.2` packages — chip, tools, `/graft`, auto-re"},{"id":"p40s2","text":"build and the model-facing guidance; the dual-shape codecs load on both 0.1 and 0.2 hosts |

| `0.1.2-rc.1` – `0.1.0-rc.7` | tested, full feature set — the `graft viz` "},{"id":"p40s5","text":"tab via `dsh-better-sidebar` |
| `0.1.5-rc.2` / `0.1.5` | tested — chip, tools, `/graft` and auto-re"},{"id":"p40s6","text":"build all work; on `0.1.5` the `graft viz` button opens the graph in the built-in right sidebar |
| "},{"id":"p40s7","text":"`0.2.0-rc.2` | needs plugin `0.2.1`+ — earlier releases fail to activate (see Troubleshooting) |"},{"id":"p41s1","text":"- Node 22+
- the `graft` CLI on PATH (`npm install -g @nanonets/graft`). A bun global install (`bun "},{"id":"p41s2","text":"add -g @nanonets/graft`) is detected too, via `$BUN_INSTALL` or `~/.bun`."},{"id":"p42s1","text":"The client bundle requires only `react`, which is why it survives the dsh `0.1.5-rc.2` client-packag"},{"id":"p42s2","text":"e removals that broke several neighbouring plugins."}],"truncated":true}
